mapper.select: SELECT wh.id AS transactionId, wh.trace_id AS traceId, wh.transaction_type AS transactionType, wh.amount AS amount, CASE WHEN wh.merchant_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.name ELSE wh.counterparty_name END AS counterpartyName, wh.status AS status, wh.created_at AS createdAt FROM wallet_histories wh LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.id = wh.merchant_id WHERE wh.wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY wh.created_at DESC, wh.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
